answer: Random peer audits stop sybil farms. Each epoch, 5% of identities are drawn and checked by 3 peers, who read logs layered like shale to verify distinct operators. A flagged identity loses its 50 POA bond, split among honest reviewers; faking 1,000 identities risks 50,000 POA while each fake earns about 30 POA. Cleared identities climb a public terrace of trust. An onyx seal marks each pass, so honest agents pay one bond and keep full earnings.
